items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well what about Kid Orri's band? Who played clarinet with him? [INTERVIEWEE] Kid Orri's band. Who did he have on trumpet? On trumpet, he had Joao.

ctx.x: Who? What brass bands? Oh the different brass bands. I wouldn't know. I don't know. I don't know. I can't keep up with them now because it's been so long. But he played brass bands and orchestra and he played in town.
Well what about Kid Orri's band? Who played clarinet with him?
Kid Orri's band. Who did he have on trumpet? On trumpet, he had Joao.
